name: Karasuzumi  Ikkatsu
source:
A former Living Dead Stalker and member of the Close Quarters Armed Martial Arts Training Unit. Died two and a half years ago, leaving behind [url=/c34603]Karasuzumi Ryoko[/url] as his widow.

[url=/c34597]Nagaoka So'un[/url] and [url=/c41454]Ichihara Tokitaka's[/url] personal god, responsible for teaching them CQAMA. A vitally important figure in [url=/c34598]Kibanohara Ethica's[/url] life as well.

His demeanor could best be described as rowdy. He had a penchant for armlocks and other types of grappling maneuvers.

[Spoiler]Resurrected by [url=/c34604]Milgram[/url] as a living dead, modified into a centuar and equipped with a gas plant.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game profile]
